scope.delta_kind: Round-1 audit of the 8 keys this PR adds, plus byte-identity proof for the 391 pre-existing pairs

ui.teamBridge.fileCard.save.context_role: accessible label for the Save button on one generic file card in a message
ui.teamBridge.fileCard.save.context_note: Downloads a copy of a file a teammate attached, through the computer's own save dialog. Named by position on purpose: the file name is message content and must never be put in this label. 'Save' as in save a copy to this computer, not save changes; use the locale's usual download/save-copy verb, matching the image tile's 'Save {label}'. Not open, preview or share.

ui.teamBridge.fileCard.saving.context_role: status line on a file card while the file is being fetched for saving
ui.teamBridge.fileCard.saving.context_note: Shown between pressing Save and the save dialog opening. Indeterminate: no percentage is available. Not uploading, sending or a message state.

ui.teamBridge.fileCard.save_failed.translation: محفوظ نہیں ہو سکی۔ دوبارہ کوشش کریں۔
ui.teamBridge.fileCard.save_failed.context_role: error status line on a file card after a save could not reach the file
ui.teamBridge.fileCard.save_failed.context_note: A temporary failure (connection or service problem) while fetching the file to save it. The Save button stays next to it, so 'try again' means press Save again. Do not imply the file is gone, the message failed, or anything was deleted.

ui.teamBridge.fileCard.too_large.translation: فائل محفوظ کرنے کے لیے بہت بڑی ہے
ui.teamBridge.fileCard.too_large.context_role: error status line on a file card when the file exceeds what this app can save
ui.teamBridge.fileCard.too_large.context_note: The file is over the app's download size limit, so no Save is offered. A fact about the file's size, not a failure of the reader's connection; do not suggest retrying.

ui.teamBridge.fileCard.expired.context_role: status line on a file card whose retention period has ended
ui.teamBridge.fileCard.expired.context_note: The shared file was removed after its retention period, so it can no longer be saved. Match the image card's 'Image expired' wording pattern. No blame, no retry implied.

ui.teamBridge.fileCard.unavailable.context_role: status line on a file card the reader cannot get
ui.teamBridge.fileCard.unavailable.context_note: Same wording for every reason (removed, withheld, no longer shared with this reader, unknown state); never reveal which. Match the image card's 'Image unavailable' pattern. No retry, preview or download implied.

ui.teamBridge.files.attached.context_role: status line on one staged file chip in the composer
ui.teamBridge.files.attached.context_note: This one file is attached to the unsent draft and will go with the message. Describes a single file (singular), not the list. Does not claim the message was sent or read.

ui.teamBridge.files.not_uploaded.context_role: status line on a staged file chip when files cannot be sent here
ui.teamBridge.files.not_uploaded.context_note: Files are turned off for this account, so nothing was attempted; the note under the list explains it. Not a failure: do not use the wording of 'Upload failed'.

verdict: ur clean: all eight values are correct Urdu, carry no bidi control characters, and follow the respectful imperative and the settled محفوظ کریں / اپ لوڈ vocabulary.
linguistic_review:
'فائل {index} از {count} محفوظ کریں' uses the respectful imperative the ur guide requires ('محفوظ کریں') and the image tile's own counter ('تصویر {index} از {count} کھولیں'). 'محفوظ ہو رہی ہے…' mirrors 'فائل اپ لوڈ ہو رہی ہے…'. 'محفوظ نہیں ہو سکی۔ دوبارہ کوشش کریں۔' matches 'آپ کے ایجنٹ کو جگانے کی ترتیب محفوظ نہیں ہو سکی۔ دوبارہ کوشش کریں۔' - the same two-clause shape and the same settled دوبارہ کوشش کریں retry. 'فائل محفوظ کرنے کے لیے بہت بڑی ہے' agrees with the feminine فائل and states the limit without a retry hint; 'فائل کی میعاد ختم' mirrors 'تصویر کی میعاد ختم'; 'فائل دستیاب نہیں' mirrors 'تصویر دستیاب نہیں'; 'منسلک' mirrors 'منسلک فائلیں'; 'اپ لوڈ نہیں ہوئی' uses the same اپ لوڈ the composer's statuses use.

BIDI: the whole file carries no U+200E/U+200F/U+202A-U+202E/U+2066-U+2069/U+061C character, and none of the eight added values does either - the ur guide forbids manual control characters and relies on FSI/PDI isolation at render time. The digits in {index}/{count} stay Latin, as the guide's numeral rule requires. Urdu punctuation is used throughout (۔ full stop, ، comma).

CONSIDERED AND REJECTED: 'اپ لوڈ نہیں ہوئی' (feminine, agreeing with فائل) -> 'اپ لوڈ نہیں ہوا' (impersonal masculine) to harmonise with the sibling 'اپ لوڈ ناکام ہو گیا'. The masculine in 'files.failed' is the outlier - that string is pre-existing and out of this PR's scope - while the new chip's own siblings agree with the file: 'فائل اپ لوڈ ہو رہی ہے…' is explicitly feminine, 'منسلک' is gender-neutral. The feminine form is the one that matches the referent, so it stays.
CONSIDERED AND REJECTED: naming the file in the saving status ('فائل محفوظ ہو رہی ہے…'). The status is drawn on the file's own card and the longest of the eight values would then be a progress line; the ur guide's terseness rule points the same way.

RTL note: none of the eight values starts or ends with a neutral-direction character, so the first-strong heuristic resolves each one RTL on its own.

THE PREVIOUSLY AUDITED 391 PAIRS: every pre-existing key/value pair in this file is byte-identical to its last audited version (unchanged-pair projection above; the textual diff is the parent's last line regaining a trailing comma plus the 8 added lines). The English context rewords only the role of ui.teamBridge.files.staged, from a heading for the staged-file list to the accessible name for the composer's list; tone, length and note are unchanged and the string itself did not change, so the existing translation still describes the same words and needs no re-audit for that edit.
